summary: CMB.TECH NV filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 9, 2026, announcing that Mineral Europa (2026, 210,000 dwt), the world's first ammonia-powered dry bulk vessel, has departed on its maiden voyage to Australia. The release touts twenty-one ammonia-powered ships scheduled for delivery through 2029, mostly within nine months, plus ammonia storage and bunker-barge investments. No transaction, securities offering, shareholder vote, or ownership change is disclosed; the filing is an operational and product milestone, not a special situation. Risk-arb angle: none.
